repairs.defect: The v1 handoff loader compared report.manifest_sha256 (raw mounted file bytes) with a canonical manifest recomputation.
repairs.repair_scope: V2 changes only the handoff comparison to report.manifest_canonical_sha256 and delegates all execution semantics to frozen v1.

repairs.defect: V1 reported 176 scientific cells and also used 176 for raw_stage_instances; 176 is one-replica row count, while the authority has 352 row/cell instances and 16 raw stage artifacts.
repairs.repair_scope: Selected v3 records 352 scientific row/cell instances, 16 raw stage artifacts, T01=16 and T02=336 without changing scientific adjudication semantics.

repairs.defect: Frozen frontier constants are 40-hex Git blob SHA-1 identities, but v1/v2 compared them to raw-file SHA-256.
repairs.repair_scope: V3 computes the Git blob identity from exact file bytes before parsing either frontier, and only after the complete 16-stage raw seal.

repairs.defect_avoided: Manual/model retransmission of large T02 blueprint text can change bytes even when semantics appear unchanged.
repairs.repair_scope: Static qualification retrieves pinned upstream raw bytes, verifies SHA-256 plus Git blob identity, then copies bytes without parsing/reserialization. Original result-free manifests are projected to a smaller label-free runtime surface.
